about: Model comparisons recorded in the Track 2 decision log. Scores are cell-mean balanced accuracy (chance 0.333). Rows under different protocols are not comparable; compare only inside one protocol_key, and prefer rows with the same id.

definitions.score: Level of the model alone under the named protocol, copied from the row named in id. null when the row gives only a difference.
definitions.delta: Difference to the reference as stated in the row (model minus reference). null when the row does not state one; it is never computed here.
definitions.n_users: Number of users whose cells are scored.
definitions.n_seeds: Seeds, draws or fits behind the score as the row states them; 1 for a deterministic fit; null when the row does not say.
definitions.shipped: true if the model family is part of the final package (the file that scored 0.844 on the hidden set); a variant row of a shipped family is true only if that variant is the shipped form or a direct reference level of it. MOR was a member of the October package and of one of the three first uploads, and is not in the final package, so its rows are false.
definitions.returning: People with earlier labelled sessions in training.
definitions.kit split: The organisers' starter split: 6 training users, 2 validation users, 2 leaderboard users.

protocols.loso10: First screen (13 Oct): each of the 10 public users held out in turn (new-user folds, 28 cells); one model per seed, 60 epochs, last epoch; no output decode
protocols.kit_prior: Kit split (October): train on the starter kit's 6 training users; score = the kit's 2 leaderboard users ('kit test'; the 2 validation users, 'kit val', are in the note); one model per seed, last epoch, with the one-step causal class-balance (prior) correction
protocols.kit_raw: Kit split (31 Oct): same split and users, raw argmax with no output decode
protocols.kit_unstated: Kit split: same split and users, member alone; the row does not say whether an output decode was applied
protocols.typical4: Typical four-user panel (5-14 Nov): mean over the 16 cells of four users (three new users under the kit split, one returning user whose first session is in training); the hardest user is left out; member alone
protocols.kit3new: Kit split, the three new users of the typical panel only (11 Nov), with the causal class-balance decode
protocols.allcells5: All cells of the five development users (typical four plus the hardest user), member alone (10 Nov)
protocols.ten_strangers: Ten strangers (from 14 Nov): each of the 10 public users held out in turn, the other nine users' first sessions in training; a family or member alone after its own causal class-balance decode
protocols.ten_strangers_raw: Ten strangers (16 Nov): same folds, one member, final test score as written by the training run

headline.protocol: Typical four-user panel (5-14 Nov): mean over the 16 cells of four users (three new users under the kit split, one returning user whose first session is in training); the hardest user is left out; member alone
headline.n_seeds: 12 for most rows; 10, 6, 5 or 1 where a row says so (see each row)
headline.caveat: Collected from 21 rows dated 5-14 Nov, not from one screen. Forms differ: one net, a family net with per-user copies and test-time views, or a vote of three nets. The level of one model moves between reads (one MOR checkpoint: 0.646 on 12 draws, 0.627 on 3 draws, T2-D463); treat closer lines with different ids as ties. The CPT pool of the ST-EEGFormer members held unlabelled windows of three of the four panel users (the two kit-validation users and one kit-train participant; D89, T2-D432); only the leaderboard user was kept out, and the CNNs never saw the two validation users.
